ORDINANCE III OF 2008
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2008
An Ordinance to amend
the Sindh Civil
Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part - I,
27th February, 2008]
No.S.Legis:1(3)/2008, dated 26-2-2008.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Civil Servants
Act, 1973, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session, and the Governor of Sindh is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Omission of section 9-A of Sindh Act No. XIV of 1973
